pr_body:
### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/36485

Problem Summary:

Previously a default install of TiDB showed several differences of current_value vs. default value when reading from `information_schema.variables_info`. A lot of these were subtle bugs.

### What is changed and how it works?

The default vs current value is stabilized, and a test is added to make sure that any new exceptions (should be very few) need to be explicitly handled.

### Check List

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- [x] Unit test
- [ ] Integration test
- [ ] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
- [ ] No code

Side effects

- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU
- [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory
- [ ] Breaking backward compatibility

Documentation

- [ ] Affects user behaviors
- [ ] Contains syntax changes
- [x] Contains variable changes
Minor changes to default values. Because most of the broken values have getter functions, it won't be user perceivable. 
- [ ] Contains experimental features
- [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility

### Release note

<!-- compatibility change, improvement, bugfix, and new feature need a release note -->

Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note.

```release-note
None
```

issue_context.title: many variables differ from tidb defaults unnecessarily
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```sql

tidb> SELECT variable_name, default_value, current_value FROM information_schema.variables_info WHERE current_value != default_value and variable_name != 'tidb_config';
+--------------------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| variable_name                  | default_value  | current_value                                         |
+--------------------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
| character_set_connection       | utf8mb4        | utf8                                                  |
| character_set_client           | utf8mb4        | utf8                                                  |
| tidb_last_ddl_info             | 0              | {"query":"","seq_num":0}                              |
| identity                       |                | 0                                                     |
| tidb_enable_mutation_checker   | OFF            | ON                                                    |
| character_set_results          | utf8mb4        | utf8                                                  |
| tidb_enable_1pc                | OFF            | ON                                                    |
| ft_boolean_syntax              | + -><()~*:""&| | + -><()~*:"&|                                         |
| tidb_txn_mode                  |                | pessimistic                                           |
| tidb_last_txn_info             | 0              |                                                       |
| tidb_stats_load_pseudo_timeout | OFF            | false                                                 |
| tidb_enable_async_commit       | OFF            | ON                                                    |
| last_insert_id                 |                | 0                                                     |
| tidb_row_format_version        | 1              | 2                                                     |
| tidb_enable_chunk_rpc          | ON             | 1                                                     |
| tidb_last_query_info           | 0              | {"txn_scope":"global","start_ts":0,"for_update_ts":0} |
| tidb_txn_assertion_level       | OFF            | FAST                                                  |
| timestamp                      | 0              | 1658505605.6795204                                    |
| collation_connection           | utf8mb4_bin    | utf8_general_ci                                       |
+--------------------------------+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------+
20 rows in set (0.01 sec)
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

This is on a default install, so ideally there are very few differences. For example, the default for `last_insert_id`/`identity` could be changed from empty string to `0`.

`tidb_stats_load_pseudo_timeout` returns `false` instead of `OFF` because the getter func is not implemented correctly. Likely the same with `tidb_enable_chunk_rpc` returning `1` instead of the string `ON`.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

See above

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

master

review_comments: This is a bug. It was returning 0/1 instead of OFF/ON.
There are 2 bugs here. first the value differed from what the MySQL default is. Second, this value was not imported correctly in bootstrapping because there was no value escaping.
This is a bug. It was returning false instead of OFF.
This is an unnecessary branch, because the default is DefTiDBEnablePaging anyway.
